measuredOn: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 16 threads, Fedora 44, headless Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.34. One run on a quiet desktop, and a fast one. The archive-restore family is from a second run, on the same machine, when ticket 17 added the three phase measurements: the parent was re-recorded with them rather than left behind, because archive-restore-db is derived as the parent minus the streaming window and phases from one run under a total from another would not add up. Small measurements wobble by tens of percent between runs, which is what the five-times budget in budgets.mjs absorbs. Re-record on the hardware a release is judged against before treating these as the last word: `npm run benchmark:long-journal -- --record` prints this block.
fixture: seed 1, 3653 days ending epoch day 20676: 3244 entries over 2632 days with entries, 396 photos (362.8MB on disk), 129 lab results, 12 milestones, 24 tags. 249 entries carry a body-region euphoria or dysphoria value (phase 5 ticket 01: entries and counts shifted from the pre-ticket-01 fixture because the new seeding draws from the same random stream). One regimen episode with a Monday/Wednesday/Friday, two-amount dose schedule (schema v38): 1473 dose events, 95% of its expected slots. 19 hair-progress stagings and 5 dated photos. Encryption on: SQLite3MultipleCiphers under a data key, photos through the encrypting file store.
